videos.title: SWSDE   Supporting VCSEs
videos.description: Henry Ireland, Adam Horton-Tuckett and Andy Gibson from the South West Secure Data Environment team gave an introduction to the support the SWSDE can provide to Voluntary, Community and Social Enterprises. Topics included a technical overview of the SWSDE, developing processes and resources, and good practice for organisations looking to make their data accessible for research.

videos.title: Process Mining Workshop
videos.description: Owen Johnson returns for a deeper dive into Process Mining

videos.title: OpenPrescribing.net
videos.description: In this talk Richard Croker - Chief Pharmacist, Primary Care at NHS Devon, and Clinical Informatics team lead at the Bennett Institute developing OpenPrescribing.net  - provides an accessible introduction to the latest suite of tools offered by OpenPrescribing. He explains how individual practices or regions can compare their prescribing practice against others, and also ensure they’re following recent changes to evidence or national guidance.

videos.title: Process Mining
videos.description:
Process mining can be useful within a data analyst’s tool kit - bridging data science methods like data mining, and process science methods like process modelling and improvement.

In this talk, the case is made that processes need to be mapped, mined and fully understood before AI can be implemented safely and equitably to improve them.

videos.title: UK Health Data Research Alliance
videos.description: An overview of the Alliance, its role in shaping the UK health data research landscape, and how researchers, both within and outside member organisations, can engage with its initiatives.

videos.title: NIHR Academy - Career Development Opportunities for Data Science in Health and Care
videos.description:
This Insight talk introduces the career development programmes available through the NIHR Academy - with a particular focus towards funding support for those using Data Science tools and methods for health and care research.

Chris and Kieran cover the range of opportunities across all career stages, clinical and non-clinical and the talk is suitable for quantitative researchers from non-NIHR backgrounds who are considering research in these areas.
 
Part of the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR), the NIHR Academy attracts, trains and supports health and care researchers at all stages of their careers, from predoctoral through to chair. A wide range of funding opportunities are available comprising personal fellowship awards, shorter training and development support as well as opportunities funded at the institutional level, including through NIHR infrastructure centres, NIHR Schools and wider NIHR capacity building structures.

videos.title: IPACS - Improving Patient Flow between Acute, Community and Social Care
videos.description:
This talk introduces the IPACS project - exploring how to optimize capacity for complex patient discharge pathways and understand how to alleviate the shortage of acute beds that results from any delays in discharge to social care .

Transferring patients from hospitals to their homes or temporary care facilities is a complicated process that requires both efficient planning and effective support. However, delays and capacity issues often disrupt this process, especially when there isn’t enough care available in the right place at the right time. Social care shortages, as the final step in the care chain, are a major contributor to these delays. In 2019 alone, delays caused by unavailable social care led to the loss of about 500,000 acute hospital bed days in England.

Researchers from the Universities of Bath and Exeter collaborated with healthcare managers in local NHS Trusts to create an open-source simulation tool coded in R. Links to the GitHub repository are included in the talk.

This adaptable and free tool models discharge pathways, known as ‘Discharge to Assess’ (D2A), and helps predict demand, capacity, and patient stay durations. By simulating scenarios, it can directly support decision-making for improving D2A services and managing seasonal pressures like winter demand.

videos.title: Data Science to improve NHS performance
videos.description:
Introducing data science and advanced analytics techniques into an NHS team can be daunting. Building on our previous SWAIH Insight talk Simon will offer a practical introduction to how you can progress from excel spreadsheets towards open coding, using NHS performance as a case study.


The talk will discuss what you need to create practical foundations for a team, explore key challenges, use cases and showcase successful pilot projects to create a blueprint for integrating data science into performance improvement initiatives.

videos.title: OMOP Common Data Model
videos.description:
A SWAIH Insight Talk from Quin Ashcroft of Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, introducing OMOP, and explaining how a small team of three people in her Trust have 'OMOP'd' their healthcare data to enable operational improvement and access to research quality data. This has involved developing methods to transform existing data from multiple sources into a single OMOP database.
16 September 2024

videos.title: SAIL Databank
videos.description:
A talk from Ashley Akbari offering an overview of the SAIL Databank, how a TRE and linked data can be used in a multi-disciplinary team to support research and improve services and people’s outcomes, using examples from the One Wales collaboration response to the COVID-19 pandemic using the SAIL Databank.

20 May 2024

videos.title: One Devon Dataset
videos.description:
A talk from Simon Chant from Devon County Council, introducing the One Devon Dataset, a linked dataset covering GP, secondary care, community health, mental health, social care and wider population data, that was established in 2020.

22 April 2024

videos.title: National Competency Framework for Health Data Analysts
videos.description: A talk from Huw Davies, introduced by Louise Taylor from NHS Dorset. An overview of the National Competency Framework, and how it can be used within your organisation for recruitment, retention and team development.

videos.title: Data Science in the NHS
videos.description:
A talk from PenCHORD's Sammi Rosser discussing the opportunities and challenges of introducing data science and open methods within the NHS.

15 February 2024
